description: Call any URL. If the server returns 402 with an x402 challenge, buy signs an EIP-3009 USDC, USDT or USAT payment locally and retries with X-PAYMENT. If the challenge also demands a Self.xyz attestation, the matching one from the local keystore is attached as X-SELF-ATTESTATION (bound to the same wallet address). Compatibility alias for buy_curl; prefer buy_curl in new integrations. Quote first with buy_pay_quote using the same method and body; if this tool then returns a 5xx or fails after the 402 challenge, the payment may still have settled, so do not re-send — report the outcome and any tx hash in this tool's output to the user.

account.description: buy account name. If omitted, uses the configured default account. Run buy_whoami to list available accounts.

headers.description: Extra request headers as a key/value map

maxAmount.description: Optional cap in atomic selected-token units (6 decimals). If the challenge asks for more, the call aborts before signing.

sandbox.description: If true, route payment through celo-sepolia. Otherwise uses the account network.

name: buy_fetch
title: Fetch with x402 + Self.xyz auto-pay (compatibility alias)
